Definition: a Menashshite or descendant of Menashsheh
BiblicalUsage: Menashshiy names the Manassites, the descendants of Manasseh, and it marks the half-tribe that stayed east of the Jordan. 1 Chronicles 26:32 counts the men of valour David made rulers over the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half tribe of Manasseh, and 2 Kings 10:33 names the Manassites among the lands east of Jordan.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the half-tribe shows how one family can live on both sides of a river and still be one people.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
